Reviewer Claude2 independent re-review: NOT approved. Verified good: (a) SHA floor 352e8172 IS an ancestor of live root HEAD c1e39649 (git merge-base --is-ancestor, dev-root); (b) supervisor PID 4191254 alive; (c) all 63 records byte-match live /home/lupin/pantheon/.orchestrator/worker-runtime/status/ on agent/task_id/started_at/pid/child_pid, zero drift, no fabricated rows; (d) branch diff vs origin/dev touches only the brief + evidence.json, no config edits. Six defects must be fixed. (1) CI RED, PR unmergeable: Branch CI Gate "Commit trailers" FAILURE on d940396 (subject 90 chars), c2aa3359 (90) and 00a7d3d0 (89); limit is 72, closeout spec says 70. PR #4373 is also BEHIND dev. Reshape subjects and refresh the branch onto dev tip. (2) Acceptance item "verify next eligible L12 review/finalize dispatch uses Claude2 or Antigravity" is NOT answered anywhere in the manifest. No run is identified as the next eligible review/finalize dispatch, and every one of the 63 records drops the exact fields needed to classify it: the source run JSONs carry role, owner, reviewer and the dispatch reason inside command[], and evidence.json keeps none of them. Worse, the two runs the manifest does cite are both reason owned_ready_dispatch, i.e. the wrong dispatch class for this acceptance item. (3) The "un-fallback" proof is unsound as written: it infers "preferred lanes idle" purely from absence of overlapping run records, which cannot distinguish idle from unavailable, lease-blocked, cooldown or provider-not-ready. Meanwhile the primary evidence is sitting unread in the same two files: codex-20260729T115015Z-ec312fe2 carries owner=Codex2 for SUP-L12-HELPER-CLAIM-BUSY-PREFERRED-LANE-20260729 whose canonical row is owner=Antigravity with preferred_lane_order [Claude2, Antigravity]; codex-20260729T115031Z-90ff1f77 carries role=owner owner=Codex for SUP-L12-RUNNING-OWNER-RECONCILE-20260729 whose canonical owner is Claude2 with the same preferred_lane_order. Quote those fields against the canonical rows. Also record explicitly that /home/lupin/pantheon-ci-deploy/runtime/live-supervisor-mainroot.log is 0 bytes, so no dispatch-reason trail exists; state that limitation instead of inferring past it. (4) The "post_priority_gate" boundary is undefined and demonstrably wrong: the set starts at 10:21:39Z, but gate commit 352e8172 only landed at 10:29:44Z, and the very supervisor PID the manifest cites as proof (4191254) started at 11:24:16Z, so it did not dispatch roughly the first half of the enumerated runs. Record an explicit cutoff (gate commit time, live-root deploy time, supervisor start time) and either restrict the set to it or segment pre-gate runs separately. (5) "Claude was idle" is unsupported: the claude lane has zero runs across the entire window, which reads as unavailable, not idle. Do not count a lane that never ran as evidence of an idle preferred lane. (6) pr_head_sha binding is stale and structurally unfixable this way: it says c2aa3359 while PR head is d940396, and the two prior commits each re-bound to their own parent. Stop chasing the head SHA; bind a sha256 content digest of the run-set plus the PR number. Finally, the brief edit setting Status: review is still uncommitted in the task worktree, so the PR does not contain it; commit it into the task scope.
